verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents scanning git repos, directories/files, and stdin streams, but there is no evidence of native support for scanning S3 buckets, Docker images, or CI logs specifically — the stdin/dir commands could theoretically be piped data from such sources, but no documentation or examples confirm this capability. Missing for 10: S3 bucket scanning, Docker image scanning, CI log scanning, any documented integration or example for these non-git sources.
